description: A Meteor Client addon for hunting, flight, visuals, inventory logistics, and utility tools.

releases.notes: **SpawnerDetector** - Digs the tunnel to the next room itself, around spawners and chests, and only places obsidian where a step really has no floor. - Uses existing holes more often: a chest in the way no longer rules a hole out, and a hole it falls into is used instead of climbing back out. - Walks straight into a water hole when Baritone stops at its edge. - Faster exits: flies up through water over dry shafts, takes off where it lands, fires a rocket right after the pivot. - WaypointFollower resumes in the direction it was flying before the dungeon. - Chests are tried up to 20 times. A chest that never opens marks the room `failed`. Chest minecarts are no longer looted. **Messenger (new)** - Private messages in movable windows over the chat, with Classic, Bubbles, Slate and Compact styles. - `MessengerBubble` HUD: round, square or rounded button with an icon and an unread badge. - **HUD** - FindsTicker shows one line per find. SpiralCoverage shows the lap progress. **Requirements** - Minecraft 1.21.11, Java 21, Fabric Loader, Meteor Client for 1.21.11. - Baritone for farming and navigation. We recommend [HunterBuddy Baritone](https://github.com/Likon69/hunterbuddy-baritone). - Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map and XaeroPlus (Fabric, 1.21.11) for maps and waypoints. Put `hunterbuddy-1.0.3.jar` in your `mods` folder in place of the old one.

A fix release, mostly about how SpawnerDetector gets out of a dungeon. Every case where the bot lost time or gave up on its own hole was traced in the logs and fixed. FarmerBuddy also got its first full mission loop.

**Dungeon exits (SpawnerDetector)**
- The bot goes back to the hole it came down and leaves through it. Baritone only brings it back to the bottom of that hole, never up to the surface, and still finds it when a creeper has blown a crater at the bottom.
- Flooded rooms: it swims toward the real entrance of the shaft instead of sinking against the floor, breaks the block in its way even under water, and gives up after 20 seconds instead of 60.
- A dry shaft with water only at the top is flown straight through, no more obsidian towers. A dry shaft with a pool at the bottom is flown from the bottom instead of taking off inside the room.
- Coming back from a second room through the tunnel, it finishes through the first shaft when it is close, and swims to a flooded shaft up to 8 blocks away instead of climbing out with Baritone.
- A block covering the hole no longer sends it to Baritone when there is room to slip out sideways under it.
- Floating builds above a hole (sky logos and the like) are no longer taken for the top of the hole, which caused slow glides, landings next to the hole and refused exits.
- Stepping into the hole now works from a dirt path, farmland, a slab or a creeper crater below the rim, instead of looping on Baritone.
- Elytra lost mid-air while climbing out are reopened, and a vine no longer holds it for 20 seconds.
- Only obsidian is placed when it needs a block. Cobblestone, dirt or stone are no longer pulled into the hotbar, so your sword stays where it is.

**FarmerBuddy (still early)**
- First full mission loop on the TreeJava core: it surveys the work zone, mines the chosen blocks with the catalog strategy, changes site when one runs out, and visits the base to deliver, with every deposit confirmed by the server and a reserve and fuel kept.
- One work zone per mission with an optional search hint per step, a count of the shulker being filled, and many fixes from review (stricter save files, fresh landing checks, 3D player range).
- Still a work in progress, so expect rough edges.

**Requirements**
Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader, Meteor Client 1.21.11 and XaeroPlus.
Baritone is needed for farming and travel: use our fork, [HunterBuddy Baritone](https://github.com/Likon69/hunterbuddy-baritone). Take the jar with `fabric` in its name, the other one does not load as a mod.

A bigger update than the version number suggests. Most of the work went into shipwreck farming, a cleanup of the older modules, and the first steps of a bot system.

**Shipwrecks and dungeons (SpawnerDetector)**
- Shipwrecks are now farmed properly: the bot finds its way between chests through water and over the deck, and takes a chest straight through the wall when it is close enough.
- A chest is never broken before it has been opened and read. If it will not open, or the server never sends its contents, it is left alone and the wreck is tried again later.
- Builds at the height limit (sky logos and the like) no longer confuse the surface checks, the takeoff search or the exit.
- Wrecks near ocean monuments are no longer skipped, and only wrecks in old chunks are drawn on screen.
- Dungeons: a dug shaft with water at the bottom is now entered from its rim, three chests in a room no longer count as a player trace, and the bot no longer gets stuck crouching at the edge of a flooded shaft on its way out.

**Rewritten modules**
- 300kmfly, h-mine, TrailFollower, ElytraBounce, the Pitch40 chest swap and the rocket-boost brake were rewritten from scratch.
- Several smaller modules were rewritten too and got clearer names: kick-alarm, heading-lock, TimerGauge, shulker-peek, hotbar-refill, elytra-keeper, sign-reader, pearl-butler.
- Inventory clicks hold the player still for one tick while moving, so the anticheat stops refusing them.
- StashFinder counts item frames correctly, pearl-butler only trusts the player named at the start of a message.

**New: TreeJava and FarmerBuddy (early)**
- TreeJava is a behavior tree core for bots: it handles pauses, disconnects, recovery and stats.
- FarmerBuddy is the first bot built on it. It mines chosen blocks around a base, stores them, and can fly between zones and restock. It is still a work in progress, so expect rough edges.

**Requirements**
Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader, Meteor Client 1.21.11 and XaeroPlus.
Baritone is needed for farming and travel: use our fork, [HunterBuddy Baritone](https://github.com/Likon69/hunterbuddy-baritone). Take the jar with `fabric` in its name, the other one does not load as a mod.

First public release of HunterBuddy, made for our own hunting on 2b2t.

The main feature is SpawnerDetector's auto-farm. It finds dungeons, flies down, mines the spawner, checks the chests, then gets back out and resumes the route. It can follow nearby rooms underground and handles flooded rooms and water exits.

Chests containing non-empty shulkers are kept and marked with a Xaero waypoint so you can come back for them.

The addon also includes flight modules, automatic restocking, inventory tools and HUDs. See the README for the full list and setup.

This release is for Minecraft 1.21.11 only. You'll need Java 21, Fabric Loader and a Meteor Client build for 1.21.11.

Baritone is required for automatic farming and navigation. We recommend [HunterBuddy Baritone](https://github.com/Likon69/hunterbuddy-baritone), which includes the changes our flight and regear modules use.

For map and waypoint features, install Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map and XaeroPlus, using their Fabric versions for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Put `hunterbuddy-1.0.0.jar` in your `mods` folder alongside the required mods.

We're still working on it. If something goes wrong, open an issue with your `latest.log` and a description of what happened.
